proof_body:
by
  intro a b h
  have hn : ‖(⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
    have : a * a + b * b = 1 := by nlinarith
    simp [this]
  refine ⟨Complex.arg ⟨a, b⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn, one_mul] at this
    exact this.symm
  · have := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn, one_mul] at this
    exact this.symm
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1 → ∃ θ : ℝ, a = Real.cos θ ∧ b = Real.sin θ
